from tomlkit import parse, aot, table

def test_aot_captures_only_its_own_keys() -> None:
    doc = parse("a.b = 1\nc.d = 2\n")
    aot_instance = aot()
    t = table()
    t["x"] = 9
    aot_instance.append(t)
    doc["a"] = aot_instance
    result = doc.as_string()
    assert result == "[[a]]\nx = 9\n"
